outcome: cardiovascular responses (heart rate, mean arterial pressure)
time to first postoperative analgesic requirement
cohort: A total of 56 patients (28 with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus and 28 without) undergoing elective cesarean section with spinal anesthesia were enrolled.
finding: Patients with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus experienced significantly prolonged sensory and motor block durations and altered cardiovascular responses (higher heart rates and increased mean arterial pressure) compared to non-GDM patients undergoing cesarean sections under spinal anesthesia.
